name: mcp-weather-server
description: US National Weather Service alerts and forecasts: get_alerts and get_forecast.
long_description: Local MCP server exposing two tools backed by the US National Weather Service API (api.weather.gov): get_alerts (active alerts for a US state or territory code) and get_forecast (7-day forecast for US latitude/longitude). Coverage is limited to the United States and its territories.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: Active NWS weather alerts for a two-letter US state or territory code.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: NWS forecast for a US latitude/longitude.
